basic_details.short_information: The Computer Services Centre of the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi needs five Sr. Project Assistants (Tech.) for the project "Maintenance and Development of ERP System" (MI02894G), funded by IIT Delhi and running up to 31 March 2027, on a pay slab of Rs.47,790 to Rs.62,350 per month plus HRA @27%. how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website of IIT Delhi (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill the form with complete information on educational qualifications, indicating percentage of marks/division, and details of work experience.
Email the duly filled form to Mr. Gaurav Munjal at [email protected].
Write the advertisement number (IITD/IRD/326/2026) on the subject line of the email.
Send the email so that it is submitted by 4 December 2026, 5.00 p.m.
For any clarification on eligibility for this post, candidates may contact Mr. Gaurav Munjal at the same email address, [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals. The notice prints the following essential qualification and essential experience for the Sr. Project Assistant (Tech.) post. B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology/Electronics & Communication/Electrical Engineering, or MCA, or M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information Technology The degree must be from a recognised university or institute. The candidate must have a consistently good academic record, with first division or at least 60% marks (or CGPA 6.0/10) in the qualifying degree. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. At least 6 months of experience in the areas below. Full-time internship experience in these areas, supported by a certificate from the organisation stating its duration and nature of work, will be counted towards this experience. Experience in the development, maintenance, or customisation of web-based applications, enterprise information systems, or ERP modules. Working knowledge of server-side programming technologies (such as Java, JSP, Servlets, Spring, or equivalent frameworks), modern front-end technologies, and relational database management systems. Experience in developing reports, dashboards, or management information systems using reporting tools such as JasperReports or equivalent technologies. Familiarity with RESTful APIs, version control systems, automated build/deployment tools, and Linux-based environments. Understanding of ERP workflows and business processes in areas such as academics, Finance & Accounts, Human Resources, Payroll, Purchase, and Inventory Management. Exposure to application security, system integration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment of enterprise applications. Ability to interact with end users, understand functional requirements, resolve application-related issues, and prepare technical documentation. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated fellowship/pay-slab of Rs.47,790 - 49,220 - 50,700 - 52,220 - 53,790 - 55,400 - 57,060 - 58,770 - 60,530 - 62,350/- p.m., plus HRA @27%. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay. It is renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The project runs up to 31/03/2027. If a retired/superannuated government employee is selected, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Tech.)
content_sections.text: For any clarification on eligibility for this post, candidates may contact Mr. Gaurav Munjal at the same email address, [email protected] . Duly filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 Certificate from the organisation stating the duration and nature of work, when full-time internship experience is claimed

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying the advertised qualification and requirement of the project post. The names of short-listed candidates will be displayed on the web link http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for the online interview. The date of the online interview is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Tech.) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 05 vacancies for Sr. Project Assistant (Tech.) under Advertisement No. IITD/IRD/326/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must be submitted by email by 4 December 2026, 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology/Electronics & Communication/Electrical Engineering, or MCA, or M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information Technology, with first division or at least 60% marks (or CGPA 6.0/10), plus at least 6 months of experience in the listed areas.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Tech.)?
Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA @27% is paid in addition to the consolidated pay slab.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec, fill it with details of qualifications and experience, and email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The advertisement number, IITD/IRD/326/2026, must be written on the subject line of the email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are shortlisted, and only short-listed candidates, whose names will appear on http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted, will be informed for an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project (up to 31/03/2027), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Does internship experience count?
faq.answer: Yes, full-time internship experience in the listed areas counts towards the 6 months of experience if supported by a certificate stating its duration and nature of work.
